runs.text: Live chat replay is on. Messages that appeared when the stream was live will show up here.
What are you doing out at night?
Yea but you had the cops called on you
This isn't some dumb 3AM challenge. It's not worth it.
Why are you walking out at a time like this especially when the cops were called on you?
hope your day is going well there
are you going for a night walk there?
I remember one night when I got back from visiting a friend in Singapore I had to take the train. Problem was that in one station all train services going west were cancelled because it was midnight
So I was forced to take the taxi and the cab driver asked if I was drunk
I wasn't and he explained that he would normally pick up people at that time of night if they were drunk
Thank you to everyone who came by~ it was really fun to walk around and talkie~ do come by on the next one•
